hook: Forty-seven gigabytes of mystery System Data.

beats.say: One developer's Mac reported forty-seven gigabytes of System Data, and none of it was photos or downloads.
It was developer leftovers: Xcode build data, Docker images, old node modules and package caches, most of it rebuildable again with a single command.
The piece maps the folders behind the bloat and the commands to clear them safely, starting with measuring first what is actually there.
